title: Ongoing psionic operation in the Pentagon

tellings.quote: spoken to people who've confirmed that there is still an ongoing psionic operation being run in the Pentagon.

plain: A psionic operation, meaning work that uses psychic or mind-based abilities, is still being run inside the Pentagon today, according to the journalist Ross Coulthart. Coulthart tells Michels he has spoken with people who confirmed this to him, though he does not name them or say what the operation does. If true, it would mean the military is still actively using psychic methods.
